fields: Original market history fields are retained, including odds, share percentages, GBP amounts, volume and timestamps; source row IDs and fingerprints are retained when exposed by the source table.
source: Supabase READ-ONLY; canonical roster provenance and table details are documented below.
source_archive_notes: Source manifest: retrospective scan cohort is 238; full-day concentrated roster is 477, which is used here. Full snapshots were NOT_COLLECTED and source collection is PARTIAL. Checkpoints come from read-only public moneyway history, joined by fixture_uid; results and alarms from research_archive. Public history tables do not expose source_fingerprint, and source IDs may be null.
missing_policy: MISSING means no source row; EMPTY means a source row has no valid odds or money values; PARTIAL means some required values are absent; PRESENT requires every outcome odds, share and amount; latest observation at or before target only; no interpolation or future substitution.
